## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue, if any.

## Validation

- [ ] Python tests and lint pass.
- [ ] Frontend build passes.
- [ ] API changes include regenerated OpenAPI and TypeScript types.
- [ ] Shared handoff changes are documented and reviewed by the consuming teammate.
- [ ] No local data, credentials, environments, or model binaries are included.

## Handoff

List changed interfaces, pending artifacts, and any limits of the validation.
